user.title: Connect to Drift Beacon

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of your Drift Beacon server
data_description.api_token: Long-lived access token created from the Drift Beacon web app

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Your access token is invalid, expired, or no longer grants access to its workspace. Please enter a new token.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Drift Beacon server. Please check the host and port.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid access token or workspace access denied. Please check your token and try again.
error.invalid_server: Server does not appear to be a Drift Beacon server. Please verify the address.
error.server_error: The server returned an error. Please check the server logs.
error.wrong_workspace: This token belongs to a different workspace. Add that workspace as a new integration entry instead.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please check the logs.

abort.already_configured: This workspace is already connected as {user_name}.

stop_session.name: Stop session
stop_session.description: Stops whatever session is live in the targeted Drift Beacon workspace. Does nothing if no session is running.

pause.name: Pause
pause.description: Pin the activity again after stopping, so it is ready to resume. Whatever was pinned moves to the front of the queue.

track_activity.name: Track activity
track_activity.description: For timed activities, start tracking or stop if already running. For point activities, record one occurrence.

pause_activity.name: Pause activity
pause_activity.description: End this activity's live session and pin it for later. Applies to timed activities only. Does nothing if this activity is not live.

pin_activity.name: Pin activity
pin_activity.description: Make this your pinned activity. Your previous pin moves to the front of the queue.

unpin_activity.name: Unpin activity
unpin_activity.description: Unpin this activity if it is pinned. With auto-advance on, the next queued activity becomes pinned.

queue_activity.name: Queue activity
queue_activity.description: Add this activity to the back of your queue. With auto-advance on and nothing pinned, pin it immediately. Each call can add another queue entry.
